name: vishap-claude
description: Security and logic analysis: Vishap's rule engine and optional exploit probes, then Claude API (Anthropic SDK).

tools.name: vishap_analyze
tools.description: Analyze code, spec, logs, or config for security risks and logic bugs. Runs Vishap's rule engine locally, optionally proves findings by running the handlers in isolation (bubblewrap/WSL), then asks Claude. Returns Markdown with CWE, proof status and fixes.

VISHAP_PROVE.title: Prove findings by running the code
VISHAP_PROVE.description: Runs the submitted Flask handlers with probe values inside bubblewrap (on Windows: inside WSL, needs 'apt install bubblewrap'). Executes the submitted code in isolation.

VISHAP_WSL_DISTRO.title: WSL distribution (Windows)
VISHAP_WSL_DISTRO.description: WSL distribution with python3 and bubblewrap, used for proofs on Windows.
